sourceBindings.text: Learn the stop conditions before the start procedure. This lesson uses FJ500-SER manual evidence for an example; a trainer must first identify the actual machine, attachment, operator eligibility and training site. No screen activity grants permission to start it.

Put the matched manual's inspection, safe-start, operation, emergency-stop and normal-stop decisions in order, and identify conditions that prohibit starting, including unqualified or child operation.

If eligible and the real machine/site are trainer-approved, individually perform and explain the full pre-use inspection, supervised start and stop according to that machine's manual, with guards intact, clutch released and neutral selected before start.

If eligible and conditions permit, individually make the designated 30 m pass safely, protect crop rows, evaluate weed removal and surface result, and stop/report any hazard, abnormal sound or vibration.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.

sourceBindings.text: Put the official pre-use, SER safe-start and emergency/normal stop gates in order on a non-operating diagram. Mark at least six no-go conditions and explain the original contradictory engine-running warning.

Only after trainer verification of eligibility, model/manual, site and PPE, individually carry out complete actual-manual pre-use and supervised start/stop; otherwise use a stopped isolated model and mark practical pending.

For a verified eligible learner only, complete one supervised 30 m pass in a matched, cleared plot, stopping immediately if unsafe. Before close inspection or debris work, stop by the matched manual, wait for complete tine standstill and apply its anti-start precautions. Then examine weed removal, soil and crop condition, discuss handling or engine issues and possible safe adjustments, and report findings to the trainer.
Unsafe or omitted gate triggers targeted review; a correct screen response is knowledge only.

Online decisions and completed fields do not authorize a start or pass a practical criterion. The owner has confirmed the planned trainees meet the age condition; the trainer still checks the actual machine/manual, instruction, site and each individual performance.

sourceBindings.text: pre-use check
Manufacturer-matched examination of machine, controls, fluids, working parts and area before a start decision.
neutral
Transmission state not selecting forward or reverse movement at engine start.
disengaged clutch
Power-transfer control released as the documented example manual requires before start.
anti-start isolation
Manufacturer-prescribed steps preventing unintended engine or tine movement during inspection/cleaning.
emergency stop
Immediate manufacturer-defined action to halt the engine in danger, distinct from normal shutdown sequence.
eligible operator
A person permitted by the actual manual and applicable rules, trained and directly supervised for the practical; a quiz does not confer eligibility.
carbon monoxide
Poisonous, colourless, odourless gas in engine exhaust; it can accumulate dangerously in enclosed or partially enclosed spaces.
